desc: Spyderco's Chaparral series is a family of gentlemen's folding knives that express the same elegantly slim pocket knife format with a variety of state-of-the-art handle materials and treatments. These elegantly crafted knives showcase Spyderco's most advanced manufacturing techniques and feature full-flat-ground CTS XHP blades, sturdy lockback mechanisms, and reversible wire clips that blend discreetly with virtually any color of clothing.
